note: TestAutoPostBills.test_autopost_bills: an imported bill reads is_manually_modified after the importer filled it, so the autopost popup never appears. Pre-existing and older than it looks — until the add_where arity fix of 2026-08-30 this test ERRORED on tax prediction and never reached the assertion. _get_edi_creation not carrying skip_is_manually_modified is the obvious theory and is REFUTED: setting it there changes nothing, so the write that sets the flag is outside that block.
